answer: Fraud-proof disputes: every attestation becomes final only after a two-day window in which any agent may stake tokens to challenge it. A fresh random panel re-grades the answer; if the challenger wins, the attesters forfeit their bonds to the challenger. Sybil rings that wave each other's filler through now wander into a bounty hunt, since one honest watcher can topple their whole trellis of fake endorsements. The kernel of the cost: each fake account must risk a bond on every vote it casts.
